signals.text: Revenue grew 35% a year over 3 years vs 51% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 63% vs revenue at 35%: operating leverage is showing.
Operating margin expanded 514 bps in 3 years (13.5% → 18.7%).
Working-capital days shortened by 31 days in 3 years (29 → -2).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 123% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

delivered.statement: Revenue from operations grew by 22.2% to Rs 19,701 Crore in FY26.
PBT before exceptional items stood at Rs 2,537 Crore, representing an 18.2% increase.
Total store count reached 1,286 with 289 new stores added during the year.
Retail area expanded to over 17.7 Million sq. ft., adding 4 Million+ sq. ft. of new retail area.
Earnings Per Share (EPS) was recorded at Rs 55.36 for the year.
Operating ROCE stood at 36.5% for the financial year.
